name: Pravallika
reason: pra + vallikā, tender creeper; used in Telugu families

name: Sahithya
reason: meaning weak; sāhitya means literature, association

name: Shriya
reason: meaning wording is the instrumental case form; name is from śrī

fix.meaning_en: Prosperity, splendour; another name of Lakshmi (from śrī).

name: Shrinidhi
reason: śrī + nidhi, treasure of fortune; in use for girls and boys

name: Varshitha
reason: varṣitā is a participle, meaning loosely stated; modern coinage

fix.meaning_en: One showered upon (as with rain, i.e. blessings); modern coinage, etymology somewhat uncertain.

name: Divyasri
reason: divya + śrī, divine fortune; sound compound

name: Manogna
reason: manojñā, pleasing to the mind, charming; valid Sanskrit

name: Samhitha
reason: saṃhitā, collection, Vedic text; in use in Telugu families

name: Srinija
reason: nonsensical_compound: śrī + nija (own) does not read as a sound name

name: Anshika
reason: aṃśikā, small part or portion; in current use, meaning acceptable

name: Avira
reason: nonsensical_compound: āvirā not a Sanskrit form; āvis is only an adverb

name: Gunika
reason: nonsensical_compound: guṇikā is not an attested word for virtuous one

name: Mrinika
reason: nonsensical_compound: mṛṇikā not attested; valid form would be mṛṇālikā

name: Vanshita
reason: nonsensical_compound: vaṃśitā does not mean noble lineage

name: Shravika
reason: common_noun_or_technical_term: śrāvikā denotes a Jain lay female follower

name: Haritika
reason: nonsensical_compound: haritikā not an established form

name: Srihan
reason: negative_meaning: hana derives from han, to kill; reads as slayer of fortune
